tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Curvature bounded at one end, unbounded at the other] The curvature is bounded in a neighborhood of one end of $U_\infty $ and goes to infinity at the other end. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch The bounded end is the limit of negative neck halves, while neck scales tend to zero along the other end.

□
